verdict.rationale: Supabase offers building blocks for least-privilege agent access: RLS provides granular in-database authorization, and custom MCP servers on Edge Functions can run each tool call as the signed-in user under RLS. The hosted MCP endpoint uses an OAuth bearer flow, and Supabase now encourages read-only MCP by default. However, the documented prompt-injection exploit shows agents running with service_role access that bypasses RLS, and nothing shows a first-class way to mint scoped, per-agent API keys or tokens. Missing for 10: documented issuance of scoped/least-privilege API keys or tokens for agents, per-agent permission scopes on the official MCP/Management API, and independent corroboration that scoping works in practice.
